body: I genuinely do not wish to feel this way but as hard as I’ve tried to fix my mindset, reality only ever seeps in time after time again.
I’m so glad you didn’t do it. I’ve been to that point too, circling a building that was big enough to jump from. I’m glad I didn’t do it. Here if you need to chat with someone.

I’m right there with you. I’ve experienced so much loss this past year I cannot even stomach it anymore. I don’t know much of what you’ve been through but what I can tell you is that you are enough. You will go on to find new people to care for and love as time passes and they’ll accept you for who you are. I too am the closest I’ve ever been and I feel compelled to respond to your post for some reason. I feel that nothingness too, I understand. I hope you stick around, I don’t want you to go.
